name: Brightcove MCP
summary: Brightcove's hosted MCP server: assistants search and update videos and playlists, manage ingest, players, live streams and SSAI, and query analytics.
description: Remote server at https://mcp.brightcove.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.0 sign-in with a Brightcove account; no API key). The account must have the MCP server enabled, and on accounts using Roles and Permissions the user also needs the MCP access role; tools available follow the user's permissions. Tool areas: Content and CMS, Ingest (captions, audio tracks, metadata), Players, Live, Analytics, Playback and delivery rules, Engagement (Gallery, Interactivity, Audience, Social) and Cloud Playout/SSAI. Tools that change or delete data are marked destructive. The catalog is large, so Brightcove recommends clients with dynamic tool loading. Requires a Brightcove subscription.

agent_access.notes: OAuth 2.0; protected-resource metadata at https://mcp.brightcove.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. Account must be MCP-enabled.
